description: District Secretariate Jaffna - The Pilgrimage (Jaffna District) Regulation 1951
categorisation: This gazette notification fixes festival periods for pilgrimages under the Pilgrimages (Jaffna District) Regulation 1951 and its subsequent amendments. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the implementation and enforcement of existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or elections.
